stemMd: Nitrogen in ammonia has three bonding pairs and one lone pair. What is the molecular shape?
explanationMd: Four electron domains arrange approximately tetrahedrally, but molecular shape names only atom positions. One domain is a lone pair, leaving three hydrogen atoms in a trigonal pyramid.

distractorRationale.c: The lone pair changes the shape from planar.
distractorRationale.e: There are only three bonded atoms.
distractorRationale.b: Three bonds around the central atom do not lie in a line.
distractorRationale.d: Six bonded directions would be required.
